
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/ClownLMe/p/19544039" title="发布于 2026-01-28 15:44">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">逆向三剑客：keystone，capstone，unicorn</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="简介">简介</h1>
<p><strong>keystone</strong> 是一个<strong>汇编器</strong>，能够将汇编代码转换成硬编码。<br>
<strong>capstone</strong> 是一个<strong>反汇编器</strong>，能够将硬编码转换为汇编代码。<br>
<strong>unicorn</strong> 是一个<strong>模拟器</strong>，能够模拟cpu执行汇编指令。</p>
<p>通过这3个工具，能够帮助我们逆向模拟分析代码，绕过动态的反调试，简化静态的vm和混淆的困扰。</p>
<h1 id="环境安装">环境安装</h1>
<pre><code class="language-bash">pip install keystone-engine capstone unicorn
</code></pre>
<p>这3个工具用法<strong>极其简单</strong>，下面通过示例来演示其用法。</p>
<h1 id="keystone">Keystone</h1>
<h3 id="示例">示例</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">from keystone import *

CODE = b"INC ECX; ADD EDX, ECX"

try:
    ks = Ks(KS_ARCH_X86, KS_MODE_64)
    
    encoding, count = ks.asm(CODE)
    
    print(f"汇编指令数量: {count}")
    print(f"机器码 (十进制): {encoding}")
    print(f"机器码 (Hex): {''.join(f'{x:02x}' for x in encoding)}")

except KsError as e:
    print(f"ERROR: {e}")
</code></pre>
<h3 id="代码解释">代码解释</h3>
<p>代码流程十分简单：<br>
<strong>初始化keystone-&gt;编译代码-&gt;输出结果</strong></p>
<h5 id="初始化keystone">初始化keystone</h5>
<pre><code class="language-python">ks = Ks(KS_ARCH_X86, KS_MODE_64)
</code></pre>
<p>初始化<code>keystone</code>引擎：</p>
<ul>
<li>第一个参数：选择指令架构例如：x86，arm......</li>
<li>第二个参数：选择模式，例如：64位，32位，小端序......</li>
</ul>
<h5 id="编译代码">编译代码</h5>
<p>将汇编转换为16进制的shellcode</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">encoding, count = ks.asm(CODE)
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>第一个返回值：机器码指令的数组</li>
<li>第二个返回值：汇编指令数量</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="capstone">Capstone</h1>
<p><code>capstone</code>的用法和<code>keystone</code>差不多。</p>
<h3 id="示例-1">示例</h3>
<pre><code class="language-python">from capstone import *

CODE = b"\xff\xc1\x01\xca"

md = Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_64)

print("地址\t\t指令\t\t操作数")
print("-" * 30)

for i in md.disasm(CODE, 0x1000):
    print(f"0x{i.address:x}:\t{i.mnemonic}\t{i.op_str}")
</code></pre>
<h3 id="代码解释-1">代码解释</h3>
<p>代码流程跟<code>keystone</code>差不多：<br>
<strong>初始化capstone-&gt;反编译代码-&gt;输出结果</strong></p>
<h5 id="初始化capstone">初始化capstone</h5>
<pre><code class="language-python">md = Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_64)
</code></pre>
<p>初始化<code>capstone</code>引擎：</p>
<ul>
<li>第一个参数：选择指令架构例如：x86，arm......</li>
<li>第二个参数：选择模式，例如：64位，32位，小端序......</li>
</ul>
<h5 id="反编译代码">反编译代码</h5>
<pre><code class="language-python">for i in md.disasm(CODE, 0x1000):
    print(f"0x{i.address:x}:\t{i.mnemonic}\t{i.op_str}")
</code></pre>
<p>使用方法<code>disasm</code>反汇编：</p>
<ul>
<li>第一个参数：机器码</li>
<li>第二个参数：第一条指令的基地址</li>
<li>返回：一个包含指令对象的数组</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="unicorn">unicorn</h1>
<p>unicorn提供的方法使用也不复杂，但需要一定的内存基础知识。<br>
下面用一个案例解释。</p>
<h3 id="示例-2">示例</h3>
<p><strong>情景模拟：</strong> 我逆向过程中发现一个xor加密代码，我需要通过模拟执行，对密文进行解密。<br>
根据汇编代码可以得知：<br>
<code>0x20000</code>存放密文<br>
<code>0x30000</code>存放结果<br>
<code>0x10000</code>中读取密钥key</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">from unicorn import *
from unicorn.x86_const import *
import struct
from keystone import *

ASM_CODE = """
&nbsp; &nbsp; MOV ECX, 5
&nbsp; &nbsp; MOV ESI, 0x20000
&nbsp; &nbsp; MOV EDI, 0x30000
&nbsp; &nbsp; MOV BL, byte ptr [0x10000]
loop_start:
&nbsp; &nbsp; LODSB
&nbsp; &nbsp; XOR AL, BL
&nbsp; &nbsp; STOSB
&nbsp; &nbsp; LOOP loop_start
"""

def get_code():
&nbsp; &nbsp; ks = Ks(KS_ARCH_X86, KS_MODE_32)
&nbsp; &nbsp; encoding, count = ks.asm(ASM_CODE)
&nbsp; &nbsp; return bytes(encoding)

CODE = get_code()

ADDRESS_CODE = 0x400000 &nbsp; &nbsp;
ADDRESS_KEY &nbsp;= 0x10000 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;
ADDRESS_IN &nbsp; = 0x20000 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;
ADDRESS_OUT &nbsp;= 0x30000 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;
REAL_KEY = 0x77 &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;

CIPHER_TEXT = b"\x3F\x12\x1B\x1B\x18"

def hook_code(uc, access, address, size, value, user_data):
&nbsp; &nbsp; if address == ADDRESS_KEY:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; key_value = uc.mem_read(address, size)
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(f"key: {hex(key_value[0])}")

def start_emulation():
&nbsp; &nbsp; try:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print("初始化环境...")
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; mu = Uc(UC_ARCH_X86, UC_MODE_32)

&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; mu.mem_map(0x0, 1 * 1024 * 1024)
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; mu.mem_map(ADDRESS_CODE, 2 * 1024 * 1024)

&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; mu.mem_write(ADDRESS_CODE, CODE)
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; mu.mem_write(ADDRESS_IN, CIPHER_TEXT)
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; mu.mem_write(ADDRESS_KEY, struct.pack("B", REAL_KEY))

&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; mu.hook_add(UC_HOOK_MEM_READ, hook_code)
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; mu.emu_start(ADDRESS_CODE, ADDRESS_CODE + len(CODE))

&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; decrypted_text = mu.mem_read(ADDRESS_OUT, 5)
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(f"解密后的文本: {decrypted_text.decode()}")

&nbsp; &nbsp; except UcError as e:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(f"模拟错误: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
&nbsp; &nbsp; start_emulation()
</code></pre>
<h3 id="代码解释-2">代码解释</h3>
<p>代码流程：<br>
<strong>初始化环境-&gt;分配虚拟内存-&gt;写入数据-&gt;添加捕获操作-&gt;模拟执行指令-&gt;读取内存结果</strong></p>
<h5 id="初始化环境">初始化环境</h5>
<p>这个跟上面的<code>keystone</code>和<code>capstone</code>一样，就不解释了</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">mu = Uc(UC_ARCH_X86, UC_MODE_32)
</code></pre>
<h5 id="分配虚拟内存">分配虚拟内存</h5>
<p>第一行是用于存放<strong>堆内存数据</strong>，第二行是用于存放执行的<strong>代码</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-python">mu.mem_map(0x0, 1 * 1024 * 1024)
mu.mem_map(ADDRESS_CODE, 2 * 1024 * 1024)
</code></pre>
<p><code>mem_map</code>用于初始化虚拟内存</p>
<ul>
<li>第一个参数：内存的虚拟地址基址</li>
<li>第二个参数：内存的大小</li>
</ul>
<h5 id="内写入数据">内写入数据</h5>
<p>第一行写入代码，第二行写入密文，第三行写入解密key</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">mu.mem_write(ADDRESS_CODE, CODE)
mu.mem_write(ADDRESS_IN, CIPHER_TEXT)
mu.mem_write(ADDRESS_KEY, struct.pack("B", REAL_KEY))
</code></pre>
<p><code>mem_write</code>用于写入虚拟内存</p>
<ul>
<li>第一个参数：写入内存的地址</li>
<li>第二个参数：写入内存的数据</li>
</ul>
<h5 id="添加捕获操作">添加捕获操作</h5>
<p>hook用于捕获数据，这里用于捕获key</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">def hook_code(uc, access, address, size, value, user_data):
&nbsp; &nbsp; if address == ADDRESS_KEY:
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; key_value = uc.mem_read(address, size)
&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(f"key: {hex(key_value[0])}")
mu.hook_add(UC_HOOK_MEM_READ, hook_code)
</code></pre>
<p><code>hook_add</code>添加hook</p>
<ul>
<li>第一个参数：捕获模式，规定什么时候触发hook，例如：读取内存，中断捕获......</li>
<li>第二个参数：触发的回调函数，回调函数各个参数如下：</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-python">def hook_code(uc, access, address, size, value, user_data):
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><code>uc</code>：模拟器对象</li>
<li><code>access</code>：当前访问类型：<code>UC_MEM_READ</code>，<code>UC_MEM_WRITE</code>......</li>
<li><code>address</code>：当前访问的虚拟地址</li>
<li><code>size</code>：当前访问数据大小</li>
<li><code>value</code>：access为<code>UC_MEM_WRITE</code>，则这里为要写入的值</li>
<li><code>user_data</code>：用户在<code>add_hook</code>时传进去的自定义数据</li>
</ul>
<h5 id="模拟执行指令">模拟执行指令</h5>
<pre><code class="language-python">mu.emu_start(ADDRESS_CODE, ADDRESS_CODE + len(CODE))
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>第一个参数：模拟执行的起始地址</li>
<li>第二个参数：模拟执行的代码大小</li>
</ul>
<h5 id="读取内存结果">读取内存结果</h5>
<pre><code class="language-python">decrypted_text = mu.mem_read(ADDRESS_OUT, 5)
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>第一个参数：读取内存的地址</li>
<li>第二个参数：读取内存的大小</li>
</ul>
